challenge_pt: Criar uma experiência de compra online que combine com a experiência premium na loja enquanto garante carregamento rápido e checkout suave.
summary_en: Fast, elegant e-commerce experience for premium delicatessen — clean UI with product-first approach.
challenge_en: Create an online shopping experience that matches the premium in-store experience while ensuring fast load times and smooth checkout.
body_en:
## Design System

Extended the existing brand identity into a comprehensive digital design system with reusable components, consistent spacing, and accessibility-first approach.

## Product Pages

Large hero images with smooth zoom functionality; clear pricing and availability; ingredient details; related products. Mobile experience prioritizes quick add-to-cart.

## Performance

Optimized images using modern formats (WebP/AVIF); lazy loading; minimal JavaScript; fast checkout flow. Achieved sub-2s LCP on desktop and mobile.
outcome_pt: Site e-commerce de alta conversão com scores 90+ no Lighthouse e experiência de usuário perfeita em todos dispositivos.
